apps.localizedDescription:
With the Spotify app, you can explore an extensive library of music and podcasts for free. Curate the best playlists and stream millions of free songs, albums, and original podcasts on your phone or tablet. Subscribe to Spotify Premium to download and listen offline wherever you are, and unlock our catalog of audiobooks.

Why choose Spotify as your go-to music and podcast app? Here, you can:
• Listen to over 100 million songs and 6 million podcast titles
• Explore our selection of specially-crafted artist playlists
• Easily search for your favorite songs, albums, artists, and podcasts
• Discover personalized music recommendations tailored to your unique taste
• Subscribe to your favorite free podcasts so you never miss an episode, and even curate your own podcast library

Spotify Free is more than a music player - find the sounds you love and stream music and podcasts online, for free. Enjoy personalized playlists or curate and share your own, discover the hottest new releases, explore upcoming events from your favorites, and more.

• Stream millions of free songs and podcasts
• Create playlists with your favorite music
• Share songs and playlists with friends and family (feature restrictions may apply in some regions)
• Discover personalized playlists made just for you, and collaborate on playlists with your friends
• Enjoy your personal Discover Weekly playlist every week
• Stay in the know with the Release Radar and New Music Friday playlists
• Find nearby events and gigs by your favorite artists
• See your most played songs, genres, artists, and more with yearly Spotify Wrapped
• Stream music across your devices with Spotify
• Use Spotify Connect and enjoy listening on smart speakers, desktop, laptop, smart TV, Chromecast, PlayStation®, Xbox®, smartwatch, in your car, and more - limited number of device models apply

Spotify Premium - a great way to enjoy the benefits of an offline music player, and stream music without WiFi. By pressing download, you can access your songs, playlists, podcasts, and audiobooks offline, wherever you are.
• Listen to music, podcasts, and audiobooks - all in one place
• Ad-free music listening: enjoy your music with no ad interruptions
• Enjoy full on-demand playback
• Audiobooks in Premium are currently available in the US, UK, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, and Canada. Discover 250,000+ audiobook titles with 15 hours/month of available listening for Premium Individual subscribers and Duo & Family plan managers.
• Superior sound quality on supported devices
• AI DJ: a personalized guide that knows your music taste so well it can choose what to play for you
• Enjoy on desktop, phone, tablet, computer, smartwatch, and in your car
• Listen and control the listening session together by hosting a Jam in real time with friends
• Download songs, podcasts, and audiobooks for offline listening, without an internet connection
• No contract required - cancel your subscription whenever you want

Spotify lets you play music wherever you are. Listen to your favorite songs and discover new music, podcasts, and audiobooks with the Spotify app!

apps.localizedDescription: ByeTunes is a native iOS app that lets you inject music (MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV) and ringtones directly into your device's media library—without needing a computer connection for every sync. It communicates directly with the iOS media database, giving you the power to manage your music on your terms.
apps.name: ByeTunes
apps.subtitle: Say goodbye to iTunes sync!
apps.versionDescription:
Hi guys, here is the 2.4 update for ByeTunes. This one is focused a lot on making downloads, backups, playlists and repair tools way more reliable and easier to use.

Downloads can now keep going in the background. If you turn on background downloads in Settings, ByeTunes can continue an active download after you leave the app or lock your phone instead of making you babysit the download screen.

There is also Live Activity support now. When background downloads are enabled you can turn on Live Activity Progress and see the current download progress on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

Metadata fetching for downloaded songs was improved too. ByeTunes can now keep track of downloaded files that still need metadata and finish that work in the background, so songs downloaded from the Download tab should still get cleaned up and enriched even if you do not manually open the Music tab right away.

Small disclaimer for background downloads:
Because of how iOS handles background tasks, ByeTunes may sometimes disappear from the screen or be suspended/terminated by iOS while background downloads are turned on. This does not always mean the download stopped. In most cases, the background download session can keep running and ByeTunes will recover the download state when the app is opened again.

If you manually force close the app from the app switcher, iOS may stop background activity until you open ByeTunes again.

Opus support was added too. ByeTunes can now detect and handle Opus downloads properly instead of treating them like an unknown audio file type, so downloads that come back as Opus should be saved and processed with the right extension.

The download queue is more persistent now. If the app closes or gets interrupted, ByeTunes saves the active queue, failed items, progress state and pending metadata work so it can recover better next time. Failed Apple Music downloads also give a clearer message now, and there is a helper to find the song on Spotify when Apple Music cannot be used for that track.

I also cleaned up the Download tab search bar. You can now use the same bar to search or paste an Apple Music, Spotify or Deezer link instead of having to think so much about where the link came from.

Backup and Restore got a big rework. There is now a dedicated Backup & Restore section with a cleaner Manage Backups screen. You can still do light database backups or full backups with song files.

Playlist backup and restore was added too. You can back up playlists using a 3mu file on your device, then restore them later, or even share them with your friends. ByeTunes tries to match the songs already on the device when restoring, so playlists can be recreated without needing to re-inject every song again.

The On-Device Library browser got a lot better. You can now browse songs, artists, albums and playlists, manage playlists from inside ByeTunes, add songs to playlists, remove songs from playlists, rename/delete playlists and export songs with a saved export folder.

The repair tools were moved into a proper Library Repair area. Clean & Repair Library is now separated from Backup & Restore, and there are clearer tools for fixing ghost songs, broken alphabetical ordering, artwork issues and album artwork refreshes.

There were also a bunch of smaller fixes and cleanups around metadata, backups, device library browsing, download recovery, queue handling and settings organization.

Thanks as always to everyone testing ByeTunes, sending logs and reporting what breaks. Hope you guys enjoy this update.

Amethyst is a Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Android, iOS, and iPadOS, based off of zhuowei's Boardwalk project.

Supports most versions of Minecraft: Java Edition, from the very first beta to the newest snapshots.
Supports Forge, Fabric, OptiFine, and Quilt for you to customize the experience with supported mods.
Includes customizable on-screen controls, keyboard and mouse support, and game controller support.
Optimized for jailbroken and TrollStore devices to enable better capabilities.
Microsoft account and demo mode support for logging into Minecraft.
...and much more!
